The same-message MODIFY already captures the Deck 1/Deck 2 labels and rendering-style buttons; recreating the colors does not further change control styling.
The broad rendering-fidelity requirement was already established at message 200, and the more specific color reference does not materially change it.
The same-message MODIFY already captures the bottom-logo and back-panel design/font instructions; the color-reference update adds no branding change.
Recreating the rendering colors does not alter bowl capacity or bowl form.
The visual color decision does not affect bowl removal, swapping, clearance, or cleaning access.
The source does not change spout location, orientation, geometry, construction, or beverage-quality constraints.
The source specifies visual colors and details rather than changing the system-layout deliverable or any current mechanical layout constraint.
The color-reference decision does not alter mixing quality, foam, texture, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The visual color decision does not affect maintenance access, serviceability, or accessible internal systems.
Recreating the rendering colors does not change splash-control targets or mitigation methods.
